description:
Compare decentralized exchange activity via DeFiLlama: 24h/7d/30-day volume, period-over-period changes, and each protocol's share of reported global 24-hour DEX volume. Filter by protocol and rank by a 1-, 7-, or 30-day lookback window.

Use when: Use for landscape questions — which DEXs dominate volume, how activity shifted week-over-week, or a specific protocol's relative share. For executable swap pricing use get_dex_quote instead.

Limitations: Third-party DeFiLlama reporting, not on-chain truth; coverage gaps understate smaller protocols. 24-hour share is computed against the unfiltered global total, so filtered results retain landscape context.

Alternatives: get_dex_quote, get_chain_metrics

limit.description: Maximum number of DEX protocols to return.
limit.title: Limit

lookback_days.description: Window used to rank the returned protocols: 1, 7, or 30 days (nearest supported window is used).
lookback_days.title: Lookback Days

protocols.description: Optional protocol names or DeFiLlama slugs, such as ['uniswap-v3', 'curve-dex']. When omitted, return the largest DEX protocols.
protocols.title: Protocols

name: get_dex_volume
title: Get Dex Volume
